title: CSOAI — Master Catalogue of All Jewels
what_this_is: The estate's master catalogue of every jewel, in one place: the 130-row state table with each row's claimed state, its state-checked state, and today's live read of the surface that row names. Supersedes the repository document docs/GSPC-MASTER-CATALOG-OF-ALL-JEWELS-2026-10-27.md, which was merged in PR #3531 on 2026-10-29 but was never published as a page a reader could reach.
what_this_is_not: not a certification, a rank, a grade or a score
not a statement that any axis is MEASURED - the board carries its own status and this catalogue neither moves it nor pre-empts the decision that moves it
not a claim that any captured artefact is true; it records what was read, when, and what came back
not a completeness claim about the estate - it catalogues every jewel the state table names, plus the missing jewels the 2026-10-27 catalogue found, and a jewel on no list would not appear here
not_a_certification: This catalogue counts and quotes. It decides nothing about whether any measured claim is true, and it grants no status to any subject.
the_three_laws: A signed artefact is not a true artefact. Signature and presence prove where bytes came from; they never prove the number inside.
The measurement must not manufacture the evidence it measures. Where finishing a jewel would mean minting the evidence, the jewel stays open and the blocker is named.
Absence is a state. A refused URL, an unreachable endpoint, an unmeasured axis: each is recorded in its own state and never converted to a zero, a failure or a score.

state_table.note: The 130 rows, their VERIFIED state, their evidence and their next step. Every row below is read from these exact bytes.

prior_catalogue.note: Merged into the repository as a document. Never published as a page. This edition is that document, state-checked and made reachable.

published_reads.note: The sha256 is of the exact bytes published at this URL, so a reader can verify the published read against the catalogue that cites it.

method.reader: Node fetch, not Python urllib: councilof.ai returns 200 to Node/curl and 403 to urllib under the Cloudflare rule `public-data: no BIC`.
method.same_origin_rule: A machine surface may not publish an absolute councilof.ai URL for a path the site does not serve. A same-origin path that is not served today is published in the estate's path:/ form with its live status beside it. Third-party URLs stay whole.

text_level_delta_since_2026_10_30.what_this_is: The first TEXT-level reading of the state table in this estate's history. The 30 October read was status-level, because the state table records HTTP status and bytes rather than a capture-time digest; that read computed a visible-text digest on every URL, so the 1 November read can be diffed against it at text level.
text_level_delta_since_2026_10_30.reading: Text changed on a URL whose HTTP status did not change is a real change in what the surface says, and it is invisible to a status-level reading. It is not a ranking, a score or a verdict: it is the digest of the visible text, twice, on two dates.
